rule: the brief's rule 8: five random linked matches per reader (seed 20261016, ctx_handcheck.py), the raw staged row read straight from the source's file printed beside the reader's values oriented to Stage 0's player A and Stage 0's row; checked by eye by the subagent (16 Oct 2026). 'ok' = winner, set scores (and tiebreak points where shown), status, seeds and the A/B orientation as the raw row says.

tennis_data.seen: Winner/Loser and W1..L5 winner first; orientation by names. Aside: Valencia 2014 is 'ATP500' in tennis-data, T250 in Stage 0 (level part: Stage 0 wrong)

api_tennis.seen: scores_json 'g.t' = games.tiebreak points (6.3 v 7.7 = 6-7(3)); trailing 0-0 sets padded to five, trimmed in every comparison

open_tennis_data.seen: ids are Stage 0's (Sackmann's); score winner first

flashscore.seen: home first, no tiebreak points; one record without set scores (New Haven 2010)

slam_feeds.seen: AO team scores with own tiebreak points; SlamTracker score_text team 1 first; seeds on both sides correct

wta_api.seen: Winner 2 = A won, 3 = B won; ScoreTbSet = tiebreak loser's points; seeds

tdi.seen: the winner read from description_score (winner first) against the team scores; team_b_entry 6 = seed 6

sofascore.seen: winner_code 1 home / 2 away; seed 11 read, entry 'LL' not taken as a seed

live_tennis_api.verdict: ok 5/5 (status and orientation; no winner or score held)
live_tennis_api.seen: LTA's surface 'grass' for Perugia CH 2024, a clay event: an LTA surface error (its surfaces disagree with Stage 0 on 8-20% of matches)

infosys.seen: raw JSONL record found by year, tournament and code; matchWinner and player seeds as read

tennislive.seen: each side's games with its own tiebreak points '7(9)'; a seed (7) Stage 0 lacks

wta_site.seen: Kaggle copy rows; one married name (Kucmova = Stage 0's Kladivova) oriented right by the other name

tml.seen: staged row by (_source_file, _row); TML's quali files carry no seeds
